subject: Flamerus Rex
text: Flamerus Rex has 2200 HP, can deal 100+ damage with most attacks, is strong against poison, and can use Rip Earth when HP gets low.

evidence.quote:
Flamerus Rex -- 2200 HP ~...The Flamerus Rex can deal 100+
          damage with most of his attacks...Because the Flamerus Rex is strong against poison, don't count
          on Tristam dealing too much damage...When the boss's HP gets pretty low, he can use
          Rip Earth, which deals a good amount of damage to both of them.

subject: Squidite
text: Squidite has 2500 HP, starts the battle with two Sparna allies, and has a weakness to Thunder.

evidence.quote:
Squidite -- 2500 HP ~...Squidite 
          starts the battle with two Sparna allies. Phoebe can easily shoot
          them down with her Bow of Grace...Use Phoebe's Thunder spell to take
          advantage of Squidite's weakness to that element.

subject: Snow Crab
text: Snow Crab has 3000 HP, is accompanied by two Desert Hags, deals 200+ damage, is weak to Thunder, and uses Tornado when HP is low.

evidence.quote:
Snow Crab -- 3000 HP ~...The Snow Crap has two Desert Hags to help him out...He can easily deal 200+ damage...Thunder works the best in this battle...When the Snow Crab's HP is low, he'll begin to use Tornado for very 
          heavy damage.
